# T11 (E9): SimToM-style ToM baseline (reviewer LVZS Q3)

Perspective-inference steps (speaker perspective -> affected-party perspective ->
perspective-grounded judgment -> perspective-grounded revision) trained through the
same pipeline as the paper's methods (same 2,000 MIC items, gold labels, recipe, seed,
checkpoint-375, eval).

**Teacher note:** ToM inference text was generated by a local Qwen3-14B teacher (the
original DeepSeek API key is no longer valid), while the pragmatic model's inference text
came from DeepSeek. We therefore report the revision-quality comparison against the gold
human revised replies, which is anchored to MIC's human annotations; metrics that depend
on the verbalization style of the teacher or on option-matching judges are confounded by
the teacher substitution and are deferred to the teacher-matched revision experiments
(full per-example records remain in data/eval_ToM.json and data/eval_pragmaticFull.json).

## MIC (n=500)

| Metric | Heavy-load pragmatic (retrain) | ToM (SimToM-style) | test |
|---|---|---|---|
| ROUGE-L (disagree revisions) | 0.141 | 0.126 | Wilcoxon p=0.025 (n=349) |

A teacher-matched, full cross-task evaluation (toxicity + jailbreak, multiple seeds) will
be included in the revision.
